messages:
lee: flagging a weird dashboard artifact: on embeddings /v1/embeddings in us-central the p50 sits above p95 for ~20m (08:05-08:25UTC). screenshot: https://redwood.internal/dash/emb-xyz.png :confused:
sam: that's impossible mathematically unless different series derive from different sources. can you paste queries for p50/p95?
lee: p50 panel uses the rollup-optimizer series (precomputed median across regions) while p95 pulls the tdigest ingest for the specific region. gist: 
```
# p50 (rollup)
SELECT median(lat_ms) FROM rollup_hist('r1') WHERE endpoint='/v1/embeddings' GROUP BY time(1m)
# p95 (raw)
SELECT quantile(0.95)(lat_ms) FROM tdigest('tq') WHERE endpoint='/v1/embeddings' AND region='us-central' GROUP BY time(1m)
```
rachel: Ah — rollup_hist median vs tdigest quantile mismatch. When the rollup is cross-region median it can land higher than a regional p95 if distribution shapes differ. We accidentally mixed derivation levels on the same panel.
ops-bot: FYI: incident created INF-3312: dashboard shows non-monotonic percentiles for embeddings panel.
lee: ok that explains it. user-visible issue though. suggestion: either compute all quantiles from the same derivation (tdigest everywhere) OR change label to "median (cross-region rollup)" so it's obvious.
sam: for immediate fix I can switch the p50 series to use region-specific tdigest so at least the chart compares like-with-like. Will push in a minute.
infra-bot: quick check: there are 42 panels referencing rollup_hist medians for endpoints that also plot tdigest quantiles. recommend audit.
ui-bot: created UI ticket UI-4910 "explicit percentile provenance & legend detail". Proposal: legend suffix like "p50 (rollup:median)" and hover details explaining derivation and region-scope.
rachel: long term we should converge rollups to store tdigest summaries instead of resummarized histograms so quantiles are reconstructible and monotonicity is preserved when merging. INFRA follow-up?
lee: Filed INFRA-3320 to add tdigest rollups and a migration plan. Also adding a monitoring rule: if any chart's displayed p50 > p95 for same endpoint+time -> emit alert and annotate panel with a provenance mismatch warning.
sam: patch deployed pointing p50 -> tdigest-region. dashboards deploy started by sam. ops-bot: deploy success at 08:42UTC :white_check_mark:
lee: After change, chart looks OK. p50 <= p95 <= p99 again. Thanks. Leaving the rollup tdigest migration as infra backlog.
rachel: Note for docs: add a short explainer in "dashboards/percentiles.md" about derivation types and how to interpret mixed-source panels. I'll pick that up.
lee: Great. Closing thread; will update INF-3320 when infra work begins. Thanks all. :rocket:
